title: New metric useful for studies of gravitational radiation from accelerating black holes of type D with any cosmological constant
summary: We apply a convenient parametrization of all Plebanski-Demianski black holes of algebraic type D with the Kerr rotation, NUT twist, acceleration, electric and magnetic charges, and any value of the cosmological constant $Λ$, recently found by Astorino. This represents a complete class of exact solutions to the Einstein-Maxwell-$Λ$ equations such that the (non-null) electromagnetic field is aligned with both the (geodesic, shear-free, double) principal null directions of the Weyl tensor.
